spec.title: Add QUICKS collapsible section to VSCode extension sidebar
spec.context:
Users cannot see or manage quick tasks from the VSCode sidebar. Quick tasks (created via /kanban-quick) are stored in .kanban/quick/{id}/ folders but have no UI representation, requiring manual file navigation.
The QUICKS section provides visual access to quick tasks directly from the sidebar, matching the experience users have with regular tasks in the TASKS section.

in-scope.item: New TreeView section "QUICKS" positioned beneath TASKS
Header buttons matching TASKS pattern: +, Refresh, Find, Collapse All
Flat list of quick tasks showing ID + title with status description
QuickPick search for finding quicks by ID or title
New Quick and QuickParser types following existing patterns

out-of-scope.item: Grouping quicks by status (kept as flat list unlike TASKS)
Editing quick content directly in TreeView
Action items like TASKS (quicks are simpler, single-commit workflow)

requirements.requirement: The extension shall register a new TreeView "kanbanQuicks" with display name "Quicks" in the kanban view container, positioned after "Tasks"
The QUICKS header shall display four action buttons matching TASKS: Create (+), Refresh, Find, Collapse All, using same icons and navigation group positions
Each QuickItem shall display "{id}: {title}" as label with status as description (e.g., "in-progress" or "complete")
Clicking a QuickItem shall open the corresponding quick.xml file in the editor using kanban.openFile command
The Create button (+) shall prompt for title via showInputBox, then execute /kanban-quick {title} in terminal
The Find button shall open QuickPick showing all quicks searchable by ID or title, selecting reveals in tree
The Refresh button shall trigger tree refresh by firing onDidChangeTreeData event
The FileSystemWatcher shall monitor .kanban/quick/**/*.xml and trigger refresh on create/change/delete
When .kanban/quick/ folder doesn't exist, the TreeView shall display an empty state (no error)
The Quick type shall include: id, status, title, problem, done, created, updated, quickPath
The quick-parser computer shall parse quick.xml using fast-xml-parser, returning Quick object

files.file: Quick interface and QuickStatus type definitions
Pure function to parse quick.xml content into Quick object
TreeView capability with QuickItem, parent tracking, find/reveal support
Wire quicks-view capability, register TreeView, commands, file watcher
Add kanbanQuicks view, commands (createQuick, findQuick, refreshQuicks), menu items

pattern.name: capability-computer
pattern.description: Strict separation of I/O (capability) from pure functions (computer). quicks-view.capability.ts handles VSCode TreeView API, quick-parser.computer.ts handles XML parsing.

pattern.name: docs-view-structure
pattern.description: Simple TreeView pattern with flat list, used as template for QUICKS. Shows graceful handling of missing folders.

pattern.name: header-action-registration
pattern.description: View/title menu items in package.json with navigation groups, commands registered in extension.ts.

pattern.name: file-watcher
pattern.description: FileSystemWatcher triggers refresh callbacks on create/change/delete events.

pattern.name: parent-tracking
pattern.description: Map-based parent tracking enables TreeView.reveal() API for Find functionality.

product.doc: Existing sidebar TreeView showing tasks by status. Header actions pattern (Discovery, Create, Find, Refresh). TreeItem types and Find Task QuickPick workflow to replicate.
Quick tasks stored in .kanban/quick/{id}/quick.xml. Simpler than full tasks - single commit workflow, no spec/plan files. Status can be "in-progress" or "complete".

engineering.doc: Three-layer architecture: Orchestrator (extension.ts) for policy, Capabilities for I/O, Computers for pure functions. TreeItem types documented. YOLO mode detection pattern.

finding.relevance: Complex TreeView with status grouping, ActionItem/FileItem children. QUICKS will be simpler - flat list, no child items.
Simpler TreeView for folder browsing. DocsActionItem pattern for header buttons. Closest template for QUICKS structure.
XML parsing with fast-xml-parser. Same approach needed for quick-parser.
View declarations, command definitions, menu registrations. Will add parallel entries for QUICKS.

pitfall.mitigation: Graceful empty state - check if .kanban/quick/ exists before reading, return empty array if not
Create quick-parser.computer.ts using fast-xml-parser (already a dependency)
Follow directive: files use correct suffix (.capability.ts, .computer.ts), no lateral capability imports, policy in orchestrator only

constraints.constraint: Must use .capability.ts and .computer.ts suffixes per architecture directive
Capabilities cannot import other capabilities (no lateral dependencies)
Policy decisions (when/whether) belong in extension.ts orchestrator
Use ThemeIcon with ThemeColor for icons (no hardcoded colors per design directive)
All exported functions must have explicit return types per TypeScript directive
No any type - use unknown and narrow with type guards

dep.name: fast-xml-parser
dep.reason: XML parsing for quick.xml, already in package.json

risk.issue: Large number of quick tasks may slow TreeView refresh
risk.mitigation: Same risk as TASKS view - acceptable for typical usage patterns
